units: metres, seconds, Y-up; original recovered world coordinates; floor y=0
selection: Full-motion validation entries, sorted by SHA256(version:name); original loader caption/crop, seed=900000+rank; same input for all three generation seeds
aggregation: Equal weight per reference clip; generated values averaged over three seeds first. Paired bootstrap resamples original-ID clusters, grouping mirrored M-prefixed IDs; missing contact speeds excluded explicitly.
contact: Both endpoint toe heights <= contact_height_m; speed is not used to define contact
skating_frame_ratio: Fraction of T-1 intervals where either low-height toe moves horizontally faster than slide_speed_mps; also report ratio conditional on any low-height toe
penetration: Mean max(-height,0) over four foot joints and all valid frames; penetration_frame_ratio uses any foot height < -0.02m
airborne: Fraction of frames where the lowest of four foot joints is above 0.05m. This includes legitimate jumping and is not a floating-error classifier.
limitations: Kinematic proxies, not force/contact simulation or mesh collision. No universal pass/fail thresholds. Validation reference and generated motion share captions/crop lengths but are not frame-aligned ground truth. These are additional diagnostics, not metrics reported by SALAD.
